ledger.note: Searched the Iroquois Enhancement by Compression project. State and company pages say it adds compression at two stations to serve Consolidated Edison and National Grid. No power plant or data center tie was found.

Searched for a data center tie to the Wright Interconnect revival. Trade press and the Iroquois project page describe moving Marcellus gas into Iroquois markets, tied to the Constitution pipeline. No named plant or data center was found.
Plainly serves the Magnolia LNG export terminal. Not searched for a data center tie.
Searched the Magnum header line in Utah. Sources cover the storage site next to the Intermountain Power Project and a hydrogen project, with no data center named as a driver.
Searched Blackfin and Matterhorn Express. Sources describe Permian gas moving toward the Houston and Beaumont area. No named customer, power plant, or data center was found.

Searched the MoGas expansion. It is described as added capacity for the St. Louis area. Ameren has data center-linked gas plants in Missouri, but no source was found linking this expansion to them. No data center tie was found.
Cougar Lateral feeds the Mustang Express line that supplies Port Arthur LNG phase two. Searched for a data center or power plant tie and found none.
